## Speaker
Langwen Hui

### Theme
An Introduction to Topological Modular Forms

### Abstract
The spectrum TMF (topological modular forms) may be viewed as the "universal" elliptic cohomology theory, blending classical modular forms with information from the stable homotopy groups of spheres. In this talk, I will give a mathematical introduction to TMF, motivate its construction using ideas from chromatic homotopy theory, and discuss some of its computational aspects.
